Aventiv® exists to empower both individuals and communities for better futures. Through the
advancement of technology, we strengthen bonds, improve safety, and create opportunities for those
who need them most.﻿

[A transparent protective case encases a smartphone with a colorful display showing various app
icons on a blue background.]
[securus technologies logo]

Securus Technologies® is commited to offering communication solutions that are affordable and
accessible for incarcerated individuals and their families while delivering the much-needed security
tools to protect facilities and the public. Securus also provides incarcerated individuals with
education, job training, and other helpful resources to support a successful reentry.

[Learn More][20]
[Two mobile devices with colorful displays and various app icons are shown in a transparent
protective case.]
[Securus Monitoring Logo]

Securus Monitoring® offers electronic monitoring solutions to support government agencies.
correctional facilities, and parole/probation officers. With more than 900 partnerships across North
America, Securus Monitoring helps ensure safer experiences for justice-involved individuals,
facility staff, and public communities during and after time served.

system that is both easy to use and monitor

## We Create Connection for Those Who Need it Most

We are an innovative technology company that is leading the way in providing affordable and
accessible reform-minded products and services. We lead with empathy to best serve the incarcerated
population and their loved ones while delivering much-needed safety and security solutions for
correctional facilities.

Our focus is to help incarcerated individuals stay connected with their loved ones, modernize
corrections with technology, inspire hope, and support successful re-entry efforts while reducing
recividism, ultimately building stronger, better communities.

## Supporting Safety and Security

###### Technology that Helps ensure safety and security for facilities, staff, and the incarcerated.

Securus Technologies® leverages technology to support government agencies and facilities to keep
incarcerated individuals safe and secure.

#### Securus Video Connect®

###### Ready to explore another opportunity on how to connect with your loved one from anywhere?

Powerful technology makes it possible. Securus Video Connect®, is a fully web-based visual
communication system that allows friends, family members, attorneys, and public officials to
schedule and participate in video sessions with an incarcerated individual – from anywhere with
internet access using the free Securus app, computer or table

[LEARN MORE][23]

> 
> - Destiny Choquette, Family

> “Amazing. I love this app. I’m so happy I can finally visit my hubby from anywhere!”
> 
> - Shanea Klemovec, Wife

# Leaders in Purpose-built Offender Management Solutions

### Information Confidence to Achieve the Corrections Mission

Abilis Solutions is a leader in the design, implementation, support, maintenance, and evolution of
comprehensive offender management solutions. With multiple implementations in diverse [corrections
agencies][32] across the United States, Canada, and Australia, Abilis delivers a proven, evergreen
OMS and the lowest total cost of ownership.

[ OMS SOLUTIONS ][33]
[ Blog & White Papers ][34]
[ Upcoming Events ][35]

## Proven OMS Solutions for Corrections
* Comprehensive modular solution, [highly configurable to satisfy unique requirements][36], and
  designed to minimize costly custom development
* Over 40 integrated modules based on defined standards from the Corrections Technology Association
* Secure, high-availability performance built on an n-tier architecture, optimized for cloud-based
  deployment

[ LEARN MORE ][37]
* Proven model for fast time to value, with go-live within 27 – 36 months
* Highly transparent approach using full featured application sandbox. Implemented at project
  kickoff, iterated multiple times with configured and custom capabilities through UAT and go-live
* Fully integrated [project management and product management][38] processes to ensure timely
  delivery of all functional requirements and detailed traceability
[ LEARN MORE ][39]
* Three software releases per year on a fixed cadence based on customer-driven product roadmaps
* Full managed services, support and maintenance
* [CORIS^{®} Community][40]
* Multiple certifications via the CORIS^{®} Academy

## Building A Community, One Agency At A Time

[People are talking at a conference.]

Introduced in 2015, the CORIS^{®} Community was established to foster collaboration among customers,
promote the exchange of best practices in the implementation and management of the OMS, and support
the ongoing evolution of the product through shared innovation.

Over the past decade, the Community has expanded to include all CORIS^{®} customers, along with key
technology partners and systems integrators, creating a collaborative ecosystem focused on long-term
success.

At the core of the Community is the active collaboration between customers. Corrections
professionals engage directly with one another to share real-world experiences, discuss operational
challenges, and exchange proven approaches to maximizing the value of CORIS^{®} within their
organizations.

Abilis supports this collaboration through a range of engagement opportunities, including virtual
sessions, targeted workshops, and periodic customer events. These forums are designed to facilitate
open dialogue and knowledge sharing across jurisdictions and stakeholder groups.

Through this ongoing collaboration, customers contribute to continuous organizational improvement,
strengthen alignment across stakeholders and partners, and help shape the future direction of the
CORIS^{®} platform.

innovations in offender management technology, and exchange best practices shaping the future of

## Building A Community, One Agency At A Time

[People are talking at a conference.]

Introduced in 2015, the CORIS^{®} Community was established to foster collaboration among customers,
promote the exchange of best practices in the implementation and management of the OMS, and support
the ongoing evolution of the product through shared innovation.

Over the past decade, the Community has expanded to include all CORIS^{®} customers, along with key
technology partners and systems integrators, creating a collaborative ecosystem focused on long-term
success.

At the core of the Community is the active collaboration between customers. Corrections
professionals engage directly with one another to share real-world experiences, discuss operational
challenges, and exchange proven approaches to maximizing the value of CORIS^{®} within their
organizations.

Abilis supports this collaboration through a range of engagement opportunities, including virtual
sessions, targeted workshops, and periodic customer events. These forums are designed to facilitate
open dialogue and knowledge sharing across jurisdictions and stakeholder groups.

Through this ongoing collaboration, customers contribute to continuous organizational improvement,
strengthen alignment across stakeholders and partners, and help shape the future direction of the
CORIS^{®} platform.

## AI dashcam video solutions

operational budget at constant risk. Standard telematics can show you where a vehicle is, but it
cannot protect you from the hidden costs and liability of a critical road incident.

Since 1994, we’ve been assisting government agencies and correctional service providers worldwide,

communities and the people whose job it is to keep them safe and secure.

# Command and Control Center

### Our Software and Apps

# EM Manager

Monitor your GPS, RF, and Alcohol caseloads on one platform. EM Manager is the command center of
your monitoring program. Mobile EM Manager allows you to perform essential monitoring functions in
the field.

[Explore Software][18]

# Allied Universal Electronic Monitoring Analytics

Allied Universal Electronic Monitoring Analytics is a comprehensive software suite that analyzes the
monitoring data of participants to determine trends of behavior.

[Explore Application][19]

# a.Check

A participant check-in app utilizing facial and voice recognition. a.Check includes self-reporting,
secure messaging, community resource lists, document sharing, and calendar reminders.

[Explore Application][20]

### Making society safer and more secure.

# Customer-Focused Services

## Monitoring Center Services

Built on a reputation of excellence, the Allied Universal Electronic Monitoring's centers operate
24/7 and offer quality service. Our extensively trained customer service agents provide responsive
and reliable customer support. We also offer customizable monitoring solutions such as alert triage,
outbound alert resolution calls, and officer notifications.

[Explore Service][21]

# Account Management

Experts on our products and software, our account managers provide training, agency-specific
services, and program support. Our customer-first culture has generated many long and loyal customer
relationships.

[Explore Service][22]

## Training and Implementation

Allied Universal Electronic Monitoring's training is effective, streamlined, interactive, and
successful. Tailored to meet the needs of the agency, our training options include onsite, webinar,
and video. Our comprehensive and efficient implementation plans are based on extensive experience
and best practices.

to devices, not to humans.*

OM SYSTEM is carrying on the tradition of imaging products from its predecessor OLYMPUS. Our goal is
to provide cameras that can be taken along anywhere. The OLYMPUS OM-1 SLR 35mm film camera from
1972, revolutionized the global market with an authentic SLR system in a compact, lightweight
design. It delivered reliability and durability in punishing high-altitude and cold environments,

# The Offender Management Solution

OMS is a secure, modern, comprehensive, and collaborative mobile application system for offender
management which streamlines: 
* Managing offenders;
* Increasing officer safety and situational awareness;
* Logging compliance checks;
* Automatically tracking statistics; 
* Exporting data in a secure, professional format.

[][4]
[][5]

# **OMS Highlighted Features**



## ****Secure & Encrypted ********

All data in OMS is secure and encrypted at the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) 256-bits level
which is considered virtually impenetrable with today’s technology as it has more combinations
(2256) than the number of atoms in the observable universe (1082).

AES is recommended by the [Canadian Centre for Cyber Security][6] for protecting up to and including
Protected B information.



## ****Maps & Navigation
## ****

OMS makes locating offenders easy; with the push of a button, any user can navigate to the exact
address (or coordinates for addresses that don’t exist) of any offender. 

This makes users who are unfamiliar with the area able to assist with minimal guidance, especially
in communities with poorly marked houses.

Additionally, OMS boasts a map view for an overview of all offenders in the area.

 



## ****Fun
## ****

OMS makes offender management fun again.

All the tedious aspects that typically come with legacy systems (Manually sorting through offenders
to determine who needs to be checked, writing on paper and making notes, etc.) are gone.

This leads to an increased desire to conduct compliance checks and translates into an incredible
amount of additional checks being performed.

 



## ****Enhanced Safety & Orientation
## ****

The visual representation OMS provides of the local offenders allows new and assisting officers to
quickly and easily increase their situational awareness and knowledge of local violent offenders and
gang members.

This greatly increases officer safety and leads to more informed interactions and planning on all
levels of Policing.

 



## ****Automatic Prioritization****

A huge challenge with larger legacy systems is determining which offenders should be checked first
and when curfews are effective.

In OMS, curfews that are effective for the current time of day are automatically shown and separated
from out-of-effect curfews.

Additionally, higher priority offenders and offenders that have not been checked recently are
immediately prioritized without any required input or action from the user.



## ****Simple & Easy****

OMS takes only minutes to familiarize yourself with and is simple while remaining user friendly. 

Changing details or conditions for offenders can be done in just a few taps and the updates are then
rolled out with the push of a button.



## ****Standardized ********

Because OMS is so easy to install and set up, it allows for a standardized system to be used by all
areas requiring offender management. 

This also makes it extremely easy to share with non-local users who are brought in to assist and
even easier to transfer the program to new members.



## ****Fiscally Responsible ****

OMS enables huge fiscal savings from not only the drastic reduction in salaried time required to
manage legacy systems but also from reduced supply fees (Paper, printers, ink, etc.)

This “green” process is also in alignment with the [Greening Government Strategy: A Government of
Canada Directive][7].



## ****Fast****

Because data and compliance checks are shared within seconds in OMS, charges will be laid much
faster and in a more coordinated manner. 

This will also enable the courts to hold local prolific offenders accountable in a much more timely
fashion while greatly enhancing public safety in the surrounding communities.

 



## ****Fully Collaborative ********

In OMS, all users may conduct checks concurrently.

OMS can also easily be shared with approved external agencies in moments. 

This allows for an efficient, coordinated partnership in shared-jurisdiction areas which will
further target prolific offenders.

 



## ****Increased Accountability****

OMS automatically uses the current time of day and GPS coordinates of the users when checks are
logged and allows members to take a photo of the location, if needed. 

This ensures that checks are actually being logged during curfew hours and near the offenders which
will improve the strength of court cases. 

Late entries are also supported but require articulation.

 



## ****Easy Status Tracking****

All compliance checks in OMS have a status which contains useful information in relation to
applicable charges and related files.

This ensures charges are coordinated and laid appropriately while also making it easy to track the
status of prior checks for local users and external agencies that are provided with the information.

 


